title: Candle Pouring Workshop at Paddywax Candle Bar Denver
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Located in Denver’s trendy RiNo Arts District, our workshop is a perfect addition to your day in this vibrant neighborhood. Whether you’re planning a group activity, exploring Denver’s creative scene, or looking for a unique experience, our candle-pouring workshop is the ideal choice.
